runtimeObservation.actualFindIndexSource: if(this.languages){let index=this.languages[language];if(index)return index;index=this.languages[language.split("-")[0]];if(index)return index;let topLang=Object.values(this.languages).sort((a,b)=>b.page_count-a.page_count);if(topLang[0])return topLang[0];}throw new Error("Pagefind Error: No language indexes found.");
runtimeObservation.actualLanguageDetection: createInstance supplies language: detectLanguage(); detectLanguage lowercases the document html lang. All six release languages have exact Pagefind map keys.

unknownLanguageBoundary.observation: Unknown-language fallback sorts by page_count and uses map insertion order to break equal counts. Sorting intentionally makes that formerly random fallback deterministic; it can select a different language. This review claims selection preservation only for the six published language keys, all exact matches. The site does not serve an unknown-locale search page.
